The Undercroft screens are not at 4 yet. I judged five screens with the critic after my two shipped changes, and all five score 2.

Shipped in this task:
- **Dark detail pane (v29.68, `cw-vdetdark`):** the detail pane in the shop, craft, hire, contracts and gambler windows is now dark instead of cream. The title is 32px, labels are 16px, the Buy button is 56px and the steppers are 48px.
- **Quieter lines (v29.71, `cw-undercroft2`):** the credits and reputation lines are grey at 16px, and hints are 16px. The picked contract row no longer has the amber outline, and the stat bars are thinner.

Critic scores after these (shots in `notes/shots/b-31-c1`):

| Screen | Score |
|---|---|
| 02 welcome pack | 2 |
| 04 stash terminal | 2 |
| 06 terms | 2 |
| 08 shop | 2 |
| 12 mainframe contracts | 2 |

Screens 03, 05, 07, 09–11, 13–18, 39, 41–44 and 65–67 have not been re-shot or re-judged since the dark pane. Their only scores are the old 2s from before it.

I stopped because the critic's biggest findings ask me to reverse his rulings:
- **Full-screen slab:** the critic wants a centred card with a close X at top right. His ruling (ui5q1h #50) is one full-width grid with one right edge. His shared style also puts CLOSE in the footer of every window.
- **"$" price:** needs his decision, so I left it alone.
- **Explaining sentences:** these are frozen text, and this task is restyle only.

I wrote what's left to do into `notes/b-31-ui-undercroft.md` and added a line to `notes/ui/changes.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: remaining Undercroft screens need his decision on the full-width shell and close-X rulings (and the "$" price) before they can reach 4; the unjudged screens still need re-shooting and critic runs.
